headline: Approved a frontage variance for a 13-lot subdivision at 63 English Range Road; accepted withdrawal of a 156-unit housing application at 19 Chester Road.
summary: Neighbors raised concerns about traffic, well water, and tree clearing on the site. The project still needs Planning Board subdivision approval.
decisions: Approved a variance allowing 130 ft of frontage on one lot in a proposed 13-lot subdivision, 5-0.
Accepted the withdrawal of the application for a 156-unit housing development at 19 Chester Rd, 5-0.
Tabled the request for rehearing of case 26-127 until November 5, 2026.
Tabled the minutes of the 9/17/26 meeting.

decision_evidence.quote: Mr. Dietzel made a motion on case 26-132 to grant a variance to the terms of Article VI, Section 165-48.B.2 of the Town of Derry Zoning Ordinance to permit 130 ft of frontage on one lot within a proposed 13-lot subdivision, where 200 ft of frontage is required.

Mr. Perkins made a motion on case 26-131 to accept the withdrawal of a variance to the terms of Article VI, Section 165.46.A to allow the construction of a 6 building, 156 unit multi-family housing development on the parcel.
Mr. Tripp made a motion to table the request for rehearing of case 26-127 until the next meeting, November 5, 2026.
Mr. Corbett made a motion to table the 9/17/26 meeting minutes.
